==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|bye}} (''archaic'' for preposition and adverb, not used for abbreviation, preferred for noun and interjection)

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:by<id:preposition>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|by}}, {{m|enm|bi}}, from {{inh|en|ang|bī||by; near; around}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*bī}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*bi||near; by; around; about}}, from  {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₁epi}}.

Cognate with {{cog|fy|by||by; near}}, {{cog|af|by||at; by; near}}, {{cog|stq|bie||near; by}}, {{cog|nl|bij||near; by}}, {{cog|nds-de|bi||by; near; at}}, {{cog|de|bei||by; near; at}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|bī}}, {{IPA|en|/baɪ/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Pvanp7-by.wav|a=UK}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-by.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪ|s=1}}
* {{homophones|en|bi|buy|bye}}

===Preposition===
{{en-head|prep}}

# [[near|Near]] or [[next]] to.
#: {{ux|en|The mailbox is '''by''' the bus stop.}}
# From one side of something to the other, passing close by; [[past]].
#: {{ux|en|The stream runs '''by''' our back door.}}
#: {{ux|en|He ran straight '''by''' me.}}
# Not later than (the given time); not later than the end of (the given time interval); [[before]].
#: {{ux|en|Be back '''by''' ten o'clock!}}
#: {{ux|en|We'll find someone '''by''' the end of March.}}
#: {{ux|en|I'll have been cycling for longer than two hours '''by''' lunchtime.}}
# After a given amount of time has [[elapse]]d or a given event has [[occur]]red.
#: {{ux|en|'''By''' February, we were all sick of the cold.}}
#: {{ux|en|[[by the time|'''By''' the time]] I realized I had left my phone at home, I was already two blocks from work.}}
#* {{RQ:Time|title=The Danger of Surrendering Your Financial Independence in a Relationship|date=April 22 2026|author=Jillian Sanders
|text='''By''' 29, my financial situation wasn’t just disorganized, it was untenable.
|url=https://time.com/article/2026/04/17/the-danger-of-surrendering-your-financial-independence-in-a-relationship/
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260422181713/https://time.com/article/2026/04/17/the-danger-of-surrendering-your-financial-independence-in-a-relationship/}}
# {{senseid|en|cause}} {{non-gloss|Indicates the person or thing that does or causes something}}: Through the action or presence of.
## {{n-g|Following a passive verb.}}
##: {{ux|en|The matter was decided '''by''' the chairman.}}
##: {{ux|en|The boat was swamped '''by''' the water.}}
##: {{ux|en|He was protected '''by''' his body armour.}}
##* {{quote-journal|en|date=September 28, 2011|author=Jon Smith|work=w:BBC Sport
|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/14998331.stm|title=Valencia 1-1 Chelsea
|passage=Valencia threatened sporadically in the first half with Miguel having a decent effort deflected wide by Ashley Cole, while Jordi Alba's near-post cross was flicked into the sidenetting '''by''' Pablo Hernandez.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220630171643/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/14998331.stm}}
## {{n-g|Following a noun.}}
##: ''There was a call '''by''' the unions for a 30% pay rise.''
## {{lb|en|not in common modern use}} {{non-gloss|Following an adjective.}}
##: ''I was aghast '''by''' what I saw.''
##* '''1874''', {{w|Thomas Hardy}}, ''{{w|Far from the Madding Crowd}}'', 2005 Barnes & Noble Classics publication of 1912 Wessex edition, p.109:
##*: In other directions the fields and sky were so much of one colour '''by''' the snow that it was difficult in a hasty glance to tell whereabouts the horizon occurred{{nb...}}.
# {{non-gloss|Indicates the creator of a work}}: Existing through the authorship etc. of.
#: {{ux|en|There are many well-known plays '''by''' William Shakespeare}}
# {{non-gloss|Indicates a [[means]] of achieving something}}: Involving/using the means of.
#: {{ux|en|I'd know you anywhere '''by''' your gravelly voice.}}
#: {{ux|en|I avoided the guards '''by''' moving only when they weren't looking.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''By''' Pythagoras' theorem, we can calculate the length of the hypotenuse.}}
#: {{ux|en|We went '''by''' bus down to the water to feed the ducks.}}
#: {{ux|en|You can only get there '''by''' water.}}
#: {{ux|en|I discovered it '''by''' chance.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''By''' 'maybe' she means 'no'.}}
#: {{ux|en|The electricity was cut off, so we had to read '''by''' candlelight.}}
#* {{RQ:Marshall Squire's Daughter|II
|passage="I don't want to spoil any comparison you are going to make," said Jim, "but I was at Winchester and New College." ¶ "That will do," said Mackenzie. "I was dragged up at the workhouse school till I was twelve. Then I ran away and sold papers in the streets, and anything else that I could pick up a few coppers '''by'''—except steal.{{nb...}}"}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1945|author=Neva L. Boyd|title=Handbook of Recreational Games|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?id=12qZwZpIwCIC&pg=PA16&dq=candlelight|page=16|publisher=[[w:Dover Publications|Dover]]|year_published=1975|isbn=0486232042
|passage=Players: Can we get there '''by''' candlelight? ¶ Gatekeepers: Yes and back again.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1960|author=w:Dr. Seuss|title=w:One Fish Two Fish Red Fish Blue Fish
|passage='''By''' the light of the moon, / '''by''' the light of a star / they walked all night}}
# {{senseid|en|authority}}{{non-gloss|Indicates an authority according to which something is done.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''By''' the power vested in me, I now pronounce you man and wife.}}
#: {{ux|en|I live '''by''' my own code of ethics.}}
## {{non-gloss|Invokes an authority in an [[oath]].}}
##: {{ux|en|'''By''' Jove! I think she's got it!}}
##: {{ux|en|'''By''' all that is holy, I'll put an end to this.}}
##* {{RQ:Shakespeare Merchant of Venice|V|i|text='''By''' [[yonder]] moon I swear you do me wrong}}
##* {{quote-book|en|year=1863|author=Sheridan Le Fanu|title=w:The House by the Churchyard|passage=''''By''' my soul! I believe something bad has happened me,' he muttered, and popped up his window, and looked out, half dreaming over the church-yard on the park beyond {{...}}}}
# {{non-gloss|Indicates a means of classification or organisation.}}
#: {{ux|en|I sorted the items '''by''' category.}}
#: {{ux|en|Table 1 shows details of our employees broken down '''by''' sex and age.}}
# {{non-gloss|Indicates the amount of change, difference or discrepancy}}
#: {{ux|en|Our stock is up '''by''' ten percent.}}
#: {{ux|en|We won '''by''' six goals to three.}}
#: {{ux|en|His date of birth was wrong '''by''' ten years.}}
# {{non-gloss|In the formulae ''X by X'' and ''by Xs'', indicates a steady progression, one ''X'' after another.}}
#: {{ux|en|We went through the book page '''by''' page.}}
#: {{ux|en|We crawled forward '''by''' inches.}}
# {{+obj|en|:the}} Acted on in [[unit]]s of the specified size or measure. {{ng|(Sometimes hyperbolically)}}
#: ''sold '''by''' the yard''; ''cheaper if bought '''by''' the gross''
#: {{ux|en|While sitting listening to the radio '''by''' the hour, she can drink brandy '''by''' the bucketful!}}
#: {{ux|en|He sits listening to the radio '''by''' the hour.}}
# [[per|Per]]; with or in [[proportion]] to each.
#: {{ux|en|His health was deteriorating '''by''' the day.}}
#: {{ux|en|The pickers are paid '''by''' the fortnight '''by''' the American bushel.}}
# {{non-gloss|Indicates a referenced source}}: According to.
#: {{ux|en|He cheated '''by''' his own admission.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''By''' my reckoning, we should be nearly there.}}
# {{non-gloss|Used to separate dimensions when describing the size of something.}}
#: {{ux|en|It is easy to invert a 2-'''by'''-2 matrix.}}
#: {{ux|en|The room was about 4 foot '''by''' 6 foot.}}
#: {{ux|en|The bricks used to build the wall measured 10 '''by''' 20 '''by''' {{nowrap|30 cm.}}}}
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} Multiplied by or {{lb|en|chiefly|South Asia}} divided by.
# {{lb|en|horse breeding}} {{ng|Designates a horse's {{l|en|sire|t=male parent}}.}}
#: {{cot|en|out of}}
#: {{ux|en|She's a lovely little filly, '''by''' Big Lad, out of Damsel in Distress.}}
# {{lb|en|chiefly|[[Yeshivish]]}} {{cap|at}}; [[with]]; [[among]].
#: {{ux|en|Are you eating '''by''' Rabbi Fischer? (at the house of)}}
#: {{ux|en|'''By''' Chabad, it's different.}}
# {{senseid|en|nautical}} {{lb|en|nautical}} In a [[windward]] direction, sailing near to the direction from which the wind is blowing.

===Adverb===
{{en-adv|-}}

# Along a [[path]] which [[run]]s [[past]] someone or something.
#: {{ux|en|I watched the parade as it passed '''by'''.}}
# In the [[vicinity]], [[near]].
#: {{ux|en|There was a shepherd close '''by'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Conrad Heart of Darkness|part=II|passage=[The helmsman] steered with no end of a swagger while you were '''by'''; but if he lost sight of you, he became instantly the prey of an abject funk {{...}}}}
# To or at a [[place]], as a [[residence]] or place of [[business]].
#: {{ux|en|I'll stop '''by''' on my way home from work.}}
#: {{ux|en|We're right near the lifeguard station. Come '''by''' before you leave.}}
# {{lb|en|uncommon|_|outside the phrase '[[put by]]'}} [[aside|Aside]], [[away]].
#: {{ux|en|The women spent much time after harvest putting jams '''by''' for winter and spring.}}
# {{lb|en|uncommon|_|except in set phrases}} [[beyond|Beyond]] or [[past]] a certain point.
#: {{ux|en|I'll somehow manage to get '''by'''.}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|-}}

# Out of the way, off to one side.
#: {{co|en|a '''by''' path; a '''by''' room}}
# [[subsidiary|Subsidiary]], [[incidental]].

====Usage notes====
More usually in compounds, either hyphenated (e.g. ''by-product'') or closed (e.g. ''byproduct''); see also ''[[by-]]''.

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|main}}, {{l|en|principal}}
